رَانٌ : see the next paragraph. ＝
-A2- Also [A kind of legging;] a thing like a خُفّ [or boot], but longer, and without a foot: (K:) described by the author of the Msb, in his handwriting upon the margin, as a piece of cloth made like the خُفّ, stuffed with cotton, worn beneath it on account of the cold: not a genuine Arabic word: (MF:) it is a Persian word, arabicized. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
